title: AI Hub
noModel: Configure an AI model in the main window first

attach.truncated: Over 8000 characters — only the first part is sent
attach.notText: Only text files can be attached: {{name}}

placeholder: Ask something… (Enter to send · Shift+Enter for newline)
emptyHintSub: Pick a workspace at the top left of the input: the AI reads code, checks git and edits files there, as far as the permission at the bottom left allows
busyApproval: AI Assistant is waiting for approval
busyHint: Still answering — stop it or wait until it finishes
hideBusyBody: Hiding only conceals the window; the answer keeps going in the background. Bring it back from the tray, the orb or Ctrl+Alt+K.
hideApprovalTitle: A step is waiting for your decision
hideApprovalBody: This step waits for you. With no answer for 5 minutes it is auto-denied and never runs.
hideWarn: This window stays out of the taskbar, so a hidden window cannot flash for attention.
copyFailed: Copy failed — select the text and copy it manually
editQuestion: Put this question back in the composer; context stays as it is
restartFrom: Drop everything after this question and send it again
threadMetaCompressed: Round {{n}} · earlier turns compressed; summary plus the last {{max}} rounds are sent
sendHintFull: Send (Enter to send · Shift+Enter newline · Esc to stop · ↑ recalls last question)

examples.daily: Write a paste-ready report from today's commits
examples.recent: What did the latest commits each change?
examples.commitMsg: Write a commit message for my changes
examples.polish: Rewrite this so I can paste it in chat:

openList: Pages and apps you can open
openNone: Nothing local matches. Press Enter to hand it to the AI
dailyTip: Write a paste-ready report from today's commits and uncommitted files

dailyStyle.chatDesc: One opening line + 3–5 points, ready for a group chat

agent.allowTurn: Allow this kind for the turn
agent.allowTurnTip: Don't ask again this turn for the same kind of action (e.g. all git add, all file deletions). Git is grouped by subcommand: allowing git add doesn't allow git pull
agent.undoPick: This round touched {{count}} files — you can restore just one
agent.allowAlwaysTip: Never ask for this kind again (saved in settings; git is grouped by subcommand, commands by program). Destructive commands and protected paths stay blocked
agent.autoDeny: Auto-denies if no answer within 5 minutes
agent.autoDenyTip: On timeout the step never runs and the model will not retry it; send the question again to ask once more.
agent.raiseWindow: Raise the window when a step waits for me
agent.noRepo: This level needs a workspace: pick one at the top left of the input, or open a repo on the Git page.
agent.conflictNote: The repository has conflicts — resolve them on the commit page
agent.retryNote: The model service is unavailable — retrying automatically
agent.toolsUnsupported: This model has no tool calling — answering without tools

computer.banner: Operating the computer · move the mouse to the top-left corner, or click Stop, to halt at once
computer.confirmTitle: Let the AI operate the computer?
computer.confirmBody: At full access with a vision model, the AI can take screenshots and drive the mouse and keyboard.
computer.confirmWarn: Screenshots are sent to the model provider (like the chat itself: not saved to disk, no keys uploaded). Move the mouse to the top-left corner, or click Stop, at any time to halt.

permission.readDesc: Reads files, searches, checks git; changes nothing
permission.workspaceDesc: Edits files in the workspace; asks before commands
permission.reviewDesc: AI checks each action first; asks you when risky
permission.shortcutHint: Ctrl+. cycles the first three levels
permission.diffConfirmHint: At edit level, ask before changing a file (with the diff); denying leaves the file untouched. Read-only and full access are unaffected
permission.placeholderWrite: What should I do? (Enter to send · Shift+Enter for newline)
permission.fullConfirmBody: At this level the AI works on files and programs anywhere on this computer: any folder, commands, starting and ending programs, the hosts file — without asking. With a vision model it can also take screenshots and drive the mouse and keyboard.
permission.fullConfirmWarn: Still refused: dangerous commands (force push, hard reset, format…) and writes to Windows, Program Files and this app's own data. Deleted files go to the Recycle Bin. Use it only for tasks you trust.

profile.title: Persona
profile.name: Name
profile.tempHint: Temperature is the API's `temperature`: lower is steadier (code, facts), higher is more exploratory (prose, ideas). Leave it unset to follow the model config; the hub applies 0–1.
profile.tip: A persona only changes the system prompt and temperature from the next message on; the permission level is what decides what the AI may do.

snippetFilter: Keep typing in the composer to filter · ↑↓ move · Enter insert
historyAtCap: At the {{n}}-session cap: the next save drops the oldest
historyEvicted: Session cap reached — dropped {{n}} older one(s): {{names}}
exportAllTip: Combine every session into one Markdown file
deleteSessionWarn: Sessions live only in this machine's database and cannot be recovered. Export first if you need a copy.
focusEmpty: No workspaces yet — add a folder at the top right
focusScanFolder: Add folder (a git repo, a workspace holding several repos, or any folder)
bubbleTip: AI Hub · click to open · drag to snap · right-click to close

chipTip.workspace: Attach the selected repos and their current branches
chipTip.git: Attach the current Git user name, email and recent commits
chipTip.dirty: Attach a summary of uncommitted changes in the selected repos

ctx.title: Choose workspace
ctx.selectAll: Select the whole workspace (services added later are included too)
ctx.emptyWs: Empty workspace — the AI works directly in this folder
ctx.removeWs: Remove this workspace from the list (files on disk are untouched)
ctx.singleNote: This level works in one workspace at a time; with the whole workspace selected, the AI can read and edit every service in it.
ctx.keptOne: This level works in one workspace at a time — kept "{{name}}"
ctx.note: The AI reads files and checks git on its own; these summaries go in up front to save a round. With read-only permission they are attached only when the question is about the project.
ctx.includeLocked: This level works in {{name}}, so it is always included

reason.override: Set by hand, next message only
reason.meta: A question about the assistant itself — answered as chat
reason.projectTask: Daily report task — uses project context
reason.signal: Mentions code, errors or paths — project context attached
reason.followUp: Follow-up to the previous project question
reason.default: No project cues — answered as chat
